test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Name the Indian who won the title at the World Chess Armageddon Asia & Oceania event in Berlin, Germany in April 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**D Gukesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian who won the title at the **World Chess Armageddon Asia Oceania** event in **Berlin, Germany **in **April 2023** is D Gukesh.
 
• D Gukesh is a 16-year-old Indian chess player who became the** world's second-youngest Grandmaster** in **2019.**
 
• In the September 2023 rating list, Gukesh officially **surpassed Viswanathan Anand** as the top-ranked Indian player.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhimanyu Mishra **is another Indian **chess player** who holds the record for being the** youngest-ever Grandmaster** in the world at the age of **12 years, 4 months, and 25 days.**
 
• **R Praggnanandhaa** is also an Indian chess player who became the **world's second-youngest Grandmaster in 2018** at the age of 12 years, 10 months, and 13 days.
 
• **Nihal Sarin** is yet another Indian chess player who became the **world's youngest International Master **in **2016** at the age of 12 years, 9 months, and 11 days.
